create: Create a viewport trail from the selected object's animated path.
Use Refresh after animation changes when Auto Update is disabled.
refresh: Rebuild the active trail from the object's current animation.
toggle: Show or hide the active trail without deleting it.
offset: Select the trail offset node so the displayed path can be repositioned.
grey: Use the neutral grey display style for the active trail.
red: Use the red display style for the active trail.
blue: Use the blue display style for the active trail.
remove: Delete the active tracer setup from the scene.
connected: Update the trail automatically while the source animation changes.
